data.title: bn-2ouro: CML relational actions and postconditions (RFC 0003 corr. 2)

data.body:
[HIGH] Candidate substitution bypasses the work fuel. `successor_work` charges one unit per template node, but `subst_int` performs a linear `bind.iter().find` for every primed occurrence and every candidate. Untrusted CML can declare many singleton-domain relational variables and repeat a late variable across many postcondition clauses. The candidate count stays one and every up-front charge passes, while substitution performs relational-count times primed-occurrence string comparisons. Models beyond the 64-variable core limit reach this loop because `ModelBuilder::build` checks that limit only after expansion. This violates INV-016 and reported `Usage`, and it permits CPU exhaustion before typed refusal.

Failure modes: CPU exhaustion or long stalls with reported work far below actual work.
Edge cases: singleton domains, repeated reads of the last binding, oversized state lists later rejected by `MAX_VARIABLES`, and several candidates that multiply the gap.
Rollback: keep relational normalization, but refuse relational lowering until substitution uses indexed lookup and downstream limits are preflighted.
Monitoring: record relational count, primed occurrence count, candidate count, charged work, actual lowering duration, and terminal error.
Validation: add a low-work-limit regression whose repeated late binding is refused before substitution. Test maximum source size, `MAX_VARIABLES + 1`, and candidate multiplication. Use indexed placeholders or charge each lookup before enumeration.

[MEDIUM] The advertised relational bound exceeds downstream model limits. This gate accepts up to 65,536 candidates and builds one `ActionDecl` per candidate, but `continuum-model-core` limits the complete model to 4,096 actions at `crates/continuum-model-core/src/model.rs:92-95,745-750`. A 4,097-candidate action, or several smaller expansions whose total exceeds 4,096, passes this gate, allocates every declaration, and then returns generic `ModelError::TooMany`. Generated labels can also exceed the 128-byte `Ident` limit after the suffix is added. This contradicts the lowering contract and the typed candidate boundary. Precompute the total expanded action count and widest generated label before the first candidate. Return a stable typed refusal or redesign the core representation. Add exact aggregate tests at 4,096 and 4,097 actions, plus generated labels at 128 and 129 bytes.

data.reason: Open HIGH resource-bound bypass in candidate substitution and MEDIUM downstream action-limit mismatch. See th-2s0fp8 and th-l7e98m.

data.body: Fixed in 6cf4f9c. A primed read lowers to an indexed placeholder ('k), resolved to its slot once when the template is lowered; each candidate substitutes it in constant time. Work is checked against the full prediction before the first candidate, then charged per node and per resolution as each candidate is built. MAX_VARIABLES is checked before domains are read. Tests: a_late_primed_read_costs_constant_work_per_occurrence (anti-vacuity: restoring the linear lookup makes it fail, 48391 -> 90412 work), a_low_work_limit_is_refused_before_substitution, model_core_variable_limit_is_preflighted, candidates_multiply_in_the_fixed_enumeration_order.

Fixed in 6cf4f9c. MAX_RELATIONAL_CANDIDATES is now MAX_ACTIONS (4096). A preflight before init enumeration and before any action is built checks the aggregate expanded action count (TooManyActions), each action's candidates, the widest generated name computed from the domain ends, and every declared name (NameTooLong). RFC 0003 Relational actions and correction 2 now state per-action bound plus aggregate check. Audit: MAX_VARIABLES preflighted; MAX_INIT_BINDINGS <= MAX_INITIAL_STATES asserted at compile time; MAX_EXPR_DEPTH was already checked before build. Tests: model_core_action_limit_is_preflighted_in_aggregate (4096 lowers, 4097 refused), generated_and_declared_names_are_preflighted (128 lowers, 129 refused).

[RESOLVED][HIGH] Commit 6cf4f9c removes the undercharged linear scan. The lowering assigns each relational variable one slot at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower.rs:503-507, emits an indexed placeholder at lines 589-600 and 1127-1139, and resolves each candidate occurrence by direct slot lookup at lines 695-700. The source path rejects more than 64 variables before domains or actions at lines 384-388. Failure modes: CPU exhaustion and false Usage underreporting now fail closed through the predicted fuel check at lines 649-653 and per-candidate charges at lines 663-679. Edge cases: singleton domains, repeated late reads, 65 variables, and candidate multiplication have committed regressions at tests/resource_bounds.rs:1130-1187 and tests/relational.rs:368-390. Rollback: reverting the slot mapping or source-limit preflight must restore BLOCK, or relational lowering must be disabled. Monitoring: compare predicted successor work, reported Usage.work, candidate count, and terminal typed refusal. Validation: the full execution path and boundary tests were inspected; this metadata-only review did not execute tests.

[RESOLVED][MEDIUM] Commit 6cf4f9c binds MAX_RELATIONAL_CANDIDATES to model-core MAX_ACTIONS at crates/continuum-cml-elab/src/lower.rs:67-73. The preflight at lines 774-829 checks each candidate product, the widest generated label, declared name lengths, and the aggregate expanded action count before init enumeration or action construction. Exact 4096/4097 and 128/129 boundary regressions are present at tests/resource_bounds.rs:1203-1251. No downstream-limit blocker remains.
